purpose: x86 __thiscall stack bytes per Steamworks method, read from the flat wrappers of Valve's 32-bit steam_api.dll by tools/steam-flat-argsizes.py; interface metadata only, no third-party bytes. hidden_ret methods return a struct through a hidden pointer, so the C++ callee cleans stack_bytes + 4. A method's N is exact for the interface versions listed under its sources; for other versions of the same interface it is a best guess (Valve bumps the version string when a signature changes, e.g. GetAuthSessionTicket grew a parameter in SteamUser021).
